shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cat lib/products.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/products/[slug]/page.tsx"; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; sed -n 1,200p 01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | grep -n -i -A3 "argument\|serializ" | head -60; grep -n "notFound\|404" 01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md 01-app/02-guides/streaming.md | head -20

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for u in "/products/lamp?currency=EUR" "/products/lamp" "/products/vase?currency=EUR" "/products/nope"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w "%{http_code} %{time_starttransfer}s first byte, %{time_total}s total\n" "http://localhost:3123$u"; grep -oE '

[^<]*

|

(EUR|USD)[^<]*

|Loading[^<]*|

(Brass lamp|Stone vase)

|noindex' /tmp/out.html | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; time curl -s "http://localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR" -o /dev/null; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -5; pkill -f "next start"

sed -i 's/(USD|EUR) 7\\d\\.\\d\\d/(USD 80\\.00|EUR 73\\.60)/' /tmp/chk/cache.mjs; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4; node /tmp/chk/cache.mjs; kill $(lsof -ti :3123 2>/dev/null || fuser 3123/tcp 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; git -C /workspace status --short; git -C /workspace diff tsconfig.json
